videos.title: Videos and comment amounts
videos.description: Parents and replies count together. Each omitted amount defaults to 100. Identical videos are deduplicated; conflicting amounts are rejected.

url.title: Video URL
url.description: A YouTube watch, share, Shorts, live or embed URL containing a video ID.

maxComments.title: Maximum records
maxComments.description: Combined maximum number of comments and replies for this video. Defaults to 100.

sort.title: Comment sorting
sort.description: API relevance ordering and YouTube's public Top comments ordering can differ.

publishedAfter.title: Scrape comments published after
publishedAfter.description: Only comments and replies published on or after this date are included. Enter YYYY-MM-DD or an age such as 1 day (today) or 2 days (yesterday and today). Uses UTC calendar days. Automatically resets sorting to Newest first. Replies are collected within qualifying top-level threads. Leave empty to disable.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Reply requests can add time. Replies count toward the amount for each video.

maxRepliesPerThread.title: Maximum replies per thread
maxRepliesPerThread.description: Leave unset for no additional reply cap.

maxTotalComments.title: Maximum records across the run
maxTotalComments.description: Optional shared limit. Allocation between concurrent videos depends on arrival order.

publicDetails.title: Public details (slower)
publicDetails.description: One additional public pass. API text, dates and likes remain authoritative; unavailable details remain null.

enableFallback.title: Verify empty API responses publicly
enableFallback.description: Retries empty responses once, then verifies with yt-dlp in the same extraction session.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent API videos
maxConcurrency.description: Workers share the private key. Public extraction is limited to two workers; reply requests to four across the run.

videoTimeoutSeconds.title: Active processing timeout per video
videoTimeoutSeconds.description: Excludes waiting in the video queue. Covers extraction and optional enrichment; partial records are retained.
